chunk_text: Account FAQ: ## Login and password reset Use the fictional sample store's Forgot password link to request a password-reset email. Customers should check spam or filtered folders and confirm they are using the email associated with the account. A reset link should be used only by the account owner. Support agents must never request a password, one-time sign-in code, recovery code, or security answer in chat.
title: Account FAQ

chunk_text: Account FAQ: ## Locked accounts Repeated failed sign-in attempts can temporarily lock a sample account. Ask the customer to pause further attempts, complete the password-reset process, and try again after the lock period shown by the account screen. If the lock continues after a completed reset, collect a non-sensitive order reference or account email through the approved support form and route it for account recovery review.
title: Account FAQ

chunk_text: Account FAQ: ## Account details Profile settings contain fictional contact and delivery details. Customers should update their own profile where available. Changes that affect an order already in progress require manual confirmation. This material is only sample FAQ text for the POC and is not an approved account-security policy.
title: Account FAQ

title: Payment FAQ

chunk_text: Payment FAQ: ## Failed payments When a payment fails at checkout, ask the customer to confirm the billing address, available funds, and whether the card issuer has declined the transaction. The customer can try again after checking those details or use another supported method. Do not ask for a full card number, card security code, password, or one-time code. If several attempts fail, route the order reference to the fictional payments support queue.
title: Payment FAQ

chunk_text: Payment FAQ: ## Double charges and authorizations A pending authorization can appear before a payment settles and may resemble a duplicate charge. Collect the order reference and transaction dates, then request a payment-record review. Avoid promising that a pending authorization has been refunded until the records confirm it. A confirmed duplicate follows the fictional refund policy and is returned to the original payment method after review.
title: Payment FAQ

chunk_text: Payment FAQ: ## Payment methods This sample checkout supports the fictional methods displayed at checkout. Invoices and payment status are available from sample order history. Support can explain an existing invoice or payment status, but must not alter payment details through chat. This FAQ is sample content only and is not a real business payment policy.
title: Payment FAQ

chunk_text: Refund Policy: ## Duplicate charges If a customer reports two charges for one order, collect the order reference, transaction dates, and the last four digits only if the customer volunteers them. Explain that a pending authorization can look like a second charge while the payment provider settles the transaction. Do not request a full card number or security code. Send confirmed duplicate-charge cases to the fictional payments review queue for a transaction check.
title: Refund Policy

chunk_text: Refund Policy: ## Refund timelines For this fictional sample store, an approved refund is returned to the original payment method. The sample timeline is five to ten business days after approval, although a bank can display the credit later. Support should confirm the order reference and refund status before quoting the timeline. If the stated window has passed, create a manual review request rather than promising a new date.
title: Refund Policy

chunk_text: Refund Policy: ## Cancelled orders An order cancelled before dispatch may not capture payment, but an authorization can remain visible temporarily. If payment was captured, the order should follow the sample refund process. Confirm cancellation status and order reference, then explain whether a refund review is pending. This content is fictional and does not replace a real merchant policy.
title: Refund Policy

chunk_text: Shipping FAQ: ## Delays and tracking Tracking details appear in sample order history after dispatch. Delivery estimates can change when a carrier reports weather, capacity, or routing delays. Support should confirm the order reference and the latest tracking event, then explain that the displayed estimate may change. Do not invent a delivery date when the tracking record does not provide one.
title: Shipping FAQ

chunk_text: Shipping FAQ: ## Missing parcels If tracking shows delivered but the parcel is missing, confirm the delivery address through the approved support process and ask the customer to check safe delivery locations. Create a fictional shipping-team investigation with the order reference and tracking number. The team reviews the carrier record before any replacement or refund decision is made.
title: Shipping FAQ

chunk_text: Shipping FAQ: ## Address changes Address changes require manual confirmation before dispatch. After dispatch, support should not promise that a carrier can redirect the parcel. Customers can view available tracking details in order history. This is fictional sample content only, not a real shipping policy.
title: Shipping FAQ
